Container.Name: kinboard-updater
Container.Overview:
Automatic updates for Kinboard's all-in-one container (the Kinboard template), the way the compose file's updater does them. Two minutes after it starts, and then every 30 minutes, it asks the registry whether the tag Kinboard runs has a newer image. When it has, it takes Kinboard's own checked database dump (into the data folder's backups), replaces the container with one that has exactly the same settings and only the new image, waits for it to come up healthy and pass a check of its database, and otherwise puts the previous container back and skips that release. A version tag (1.18.0) never moves. Kinboard's Settings shows what it did.
It needs the Docker socket to pull and replace containers, and whoever holds that controls the server: this is the only container that gets it. It opens no port. It only ever replaces the one container named under "Kinboard container" (KINBOARD_AIO_CONTAINER), and only while that runs the all-in-one image.
Leave Kinboard out of the Auto Update Applications plugin while this runs: that plugin takes no backup and does not go back when an update fails. To pause, set KINBOARD_UPDATE_TICK to off.
Container.Requires: The Kinboard template (the all-in-one container) on this server.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Docker's socket, to pull images and replace the Kinboard container. Only this container gets it.

Config.Name: Updater folder
Config.Description: The updater's log and its record of an update in progress, so that one cut short (a reboot mid-update) is put back.

Config.Name: Kinboard container
Config.Description: The name of the Kinboard container this updater looks after (the Name in its template).

Config.Name: Automatic updates
Config.Description: on, or off to pause them (read when the container starts).

Config.Name: KINBOARD_UPDATER
Config.Description: Set as compose.yml's updater sets it.
